scope: Exact finite-dimensional construction and iff criterion for completing a supplied full-column D2 into an acyclic Euler-zero three-term complex.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: finite three-term complex C2 to C1 to C0
gu_typed_objects.action_owner: absent; construction does not select GU action coefficients
gu_typed_objects.target: acyclic completion after a full-column D2 is supplied

theorem.fixed_D2: If D2 has full column rank, D1 D2=0 makes D1 descend to C1/im(D2).
theorem.euler_zero: When dim(C1)-dim(C2)=dim(C0), the complex is acyclic iff the descended D1 is an isomorphism.
theorem.construction: Choose a row basis L of the annihilator of im(D2) and any invertible A; D1=A L is an exact completion.
theorem.ceiling: The construction starts after D2 and its domain are supplied and does not select physical coefficients.

claim_ceiling: Exact conditional finite-dimensional construction only. No action-owned D2, physical domain, properness or physical cohomology follows.
